summary:
Completed implementation of real ringing task alarms in DayFlow:
- Room v4 migration with alarm properties for both ReminderEntity and Task
- AlarmService with USAGE_ALARM audio stream, looping MediaPlayer, vibration, WakeLock, and ongoing full-screen notification
- Full-screen AlarmActivity with digital clock, pulsing alarm ring, single-tap Snooze, and Slide-to-Dismiss slider
- Native AlarmClockInfo exact scheduling via ReminderScheduler
- Task composer with Ringing Alarm switch, system ringtone audio preview, and snooze duration picker
- Notification & Settings diagnostics with Test Alarm button
- 100% test pass rate for all unit and Robolectric tests
